records.title: Austrian Foreign Ministry website accessed without authorization
records.victim: Austrian Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs
records.what: Unauthorized access to an externally operated ministry website occurred November 12–13. An investigation confirmed viewing of staff names and official contact details, but did not establish theft or compromise of citizens' data.
records.significance: Confirmed intrusion into government web infrastructure with staff directory information accessed.

severity_evidence.reason: Platform interruption over several days and $70,000 in gift-card redemptions; $2.5 million is an upper estimate of foregone revenue, not verified loss.

records.title: GlobeTopper compromised; gift cards redeemed and platform disrupted
records.what: GlobeTopper disclosed unauthorized platform access, theft of business customer API keys, and approximately $70,000 in unauthorized gift-card redemption. Systems were taken offline October 23 and commercial operations resumed in stages November 1. A $2.5 million estimate represents potentially unrealized revenue, not confirmed net loss.
records.significance: Confirmed disruption of a B2B prepaid and gift-card platform with credential exposure and unrecoverable unauthorized redemptions.

records.title: Together AI prompt samples exposed through compromised credential
records.victim: Together AI customers using affected hosted models
records.what: Together AI disclosed that an AI coding agent exposed a repository credential, enabling an unauthorized party to download stored prompt samples from June and July. OpenRouter removed affected providers after Dragos canary testing found leakage.
records.significance: AI inference customer prompts were accessed without authorization after a repository credential exposure.
